title: Regen
description: [gold]Regen[/gold] heals HP at the end of your turn. Each turn, [gold]Regen[/gold] is reduced by [blue]1[/blue].
smart_description: At the end of your turn, heal [blue]{Amount}[/blue] HP, then reduce [gold]Regen[/gold] by [blue]1[/blue].
